newsitem.title: CHINA: China nuclear plant runs at high capacity 180 days.
newsitem.headline: China nuclear plant runs at high capacity 180 days.

text.p: The Qinshan nuclear power station in eastern China's Zhejiang province has operated at high capacity for more than 180 successive days, a record for the plant, the Xinhua news agency said.

Qinshan, China's first domestically designed and built nuclear power plant, had been running at high capacity since April 25, longer than the earlier record of 179 days, the agency quoted the China National Nuclear Corp as saying on Thursday.

Qinshan generated 909,000 megawatt-hours of electricity in the first half of 1996, down four percent from last year, state media have said. Officials blamed the fall on refuelling and maintenance work.

The first phase of the plant went into operation in 1991, with an installed capacity of 300 megawatts. China earlier this year began construction of a second phase designed to add two 600 megawatt generating units by 2003.
